subject: MSA prep: short demo window + redline transfer
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@scaleworks.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@scaleworks.com
Date: Sun, 16 Nov 2025 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MSA / demo cadence — tight window next week

Hi Markus / Kimberly,

Thanks for the draft MSA — Tom and I reviewed and we have a handful of quick redlines, but more importantly our procurement deadline landed earlier than expected. We need to compress the demo and legal walkthrough into a narrower slot so we can close the purchase order by the end of next week.

Can you propose 2x 45-minute windows (one demo+q&a, one MSA redline call) on Nov 19 or Nov 20 that would work for your legal and engineering folks? We have limited flexibility in the EU timezone but can do a late afternoon CET slot.

Also attaching a short evidence inventory we need for our security committee — can the legal team confirm who will own each item? (attachment: evidence_inventory.xlsx)

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement, ScaleWorks
(elena@scaleworks.com)

Attachments: evidence_inventory.xlsx
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@scaleworks.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MSA / demo cadence — tight window next week

Elena —

Appreciate the heads up and the evidence list. We'll do our best to compress without cutting the essentials. Proposed slots (CET):
- Nov 19, 16:00-16:45 CET — demo + Q&A with engineering (Lukas will join)
- Nov 20, 09:30-10:15 CET — legal redline walkthrough with Kimberly + Laura

If those don't work we can swap the order (legal then demo) but Kimberly flagged that she needs at least 24h to prepare on the revised clause set if we move earlier.

Laura / Kimberly — can you confirm availability and who will own the evidence items Elena listed? I attached the latest MSA draft (redwood_msa_v3.docx) and a compact agenda (agenda-demo-compact.pdf).

Thanks — Mark
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions 
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Thanks Markus / Elena —

I can take the Nov 20 legal walkthrough at 09:30-10:15 CET but I need the final redlines by EOD Nov 18 to review and assign internal owners for the evidence checklist. Laura — can you confirm who will own item 3 (SOC evidence) and item 7 (data retention policy)?

Elena — quick ask: could you share the list of attendees on your side (legal + IT) so we can tailor the agenda? If procurement will only be on the redline call, we can keep the demo strictly product-focused.

If we need to compress further, Marissa can serve as fallback for the demo Q&A.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Elena Rossi <elena@scaleworks.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <t.blake@scaleworks.com>, procurement@scaleworks.com
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 14:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MSA / demo cadence — tight window next week

Perfect — Nov 19 demo at 16:00 CET and Nov 20 legal at 09:30 CET work for us. Attendees: Tom Blake (CTO, will join demo), Paolo (IT security, will join redline call), and I (procurement). We’ll keep procurement on the redline call only.

I attached our signed intake and a short note with the committee's top priorities (we highlighted SOC evidence as critical). We will try to get redline comments to you by EOD Nov 18 but it may be late — if that happens, can Kimberly do a rapid triage live during the call and mark follow-ups?

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the run-through.

Elena
Head of Procurement, ScaleWorks

Attachments: intake_signed.pdf, committee_priorities.txt
